product_overview: Inkwell is an AI-powered document editor that combines a rich text editor, a per-document knowledge base, and a context-aware AI co-writer to help users write with clarity and confidence.
core_goals: Provide a distraction-free rich text editor with real-time auto-save and robust formatting
Give users a per-document knowledge base so AI suggestions use relevant context
Offer an integrated AI chat co-writer that matches document tone and can insert responses
Enable simple document management (create, list, open, delete) behind secure authentication
Convert free users to paid subscribers via a clear free-trial and Polar checkout flow

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Marketing landing page with hero content and CTAs that route users to authentication or the dashboard when signed in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See hero and CTAs -> Click Try Inkwell free -> Navigate to /auth
Navigate to / -> Click Log in to navigate to auth -> Navigate to /auth
Navigate to / -> Click Dashboard when authenticated -> Navigate to /dashboard
Navigate to / -> Click Dashboard when not authenticated -> Redirect to /auth -> See auth page

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Sign in and sign up with email and password via Convex Auth, supporting toggling between modes and showing errors for invalid credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Toggle to Sign Up mode -> Fill name input field -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Create Account button -> Redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /auth -> Toggle to Sign In mode -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button -> Redirect to /dashboard

Navigate to /auth -> Toggle to Sign In mode -> Fill email input field with unknown email -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button -> See error message on invalid credentials -> Remain on /auth
Navigate to /auth -> Toggle to Sign Up mode -> Fill email input field with invalid format -> Fill password input field -> Click Create Account button -> See validation error -> Remain on /auth

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated document list where users can view existing documents, create new documents, open documents in the editor, and see an empty state when no documents exist.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View list of documents -> Click document card to open -> Navigate to /document/:id
Navigate to /dashboard -> View list of documents -> Click New Document -> Create document via API -> Navigate to /document/:id
Navigate to /dashboard -> See empty state when no documents -> Click New Document -> Create document via API -> Navigate to /document/:id
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click New Document -> API returns error creating document -> See error notification -> Remain on /dashboard

features.name: Document Editor
features.description: Rich text editor with auto-save, a left knowledge panel for per-document reference entries, and a right AI chat panel that uses document content and knowledge entries as context and can insert responses into the document.
user_flows: Navigate to /document/:id -> See document title and content loaded -> Edit document title -> Type in rich text editor -> Auto-save triggers
Navigate to /document/:id -> Toggle knowledge panel -> See knowledge panel open -> Add knowledge entry title -> Add knowledge entry content -> Save entry -> See entry in knowledge list

Navigate to /document/:id -> Toggle AI chat panel -> Type message in chat input -> Click Send message to AI chat -> Wait for AI response -> See AI response in chat -> Click Insert AI response into document -> Inserted content appears in editor -> Auto-save triggers
Navigate to /document/:id -> Toggle knowledge panel -> Click Add knowledge entry -> Leave title empty -> Click Save -> See validation error for title -> Knowledge entry not saved
Navigate to /document/:id -> Toggle AI chat panel -> Type message in chat input -> Click Send message to AI chat -> AI generation action fails -> See error message in chat panel -> Click Retry send

features.name: Profile
features.description: User profile page where authenticated users can view their name and email and update their display name.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> See name and email displayed -> Edit name field -> Click Save Changes -> See saved confirmation
Navigate to /profile -> Edit name field to empty value -> Click Save Changes -> See validation error -> Name not saved
Navigate to /profile -> View email field -> Email field is read-only
